newsitem.title: USA: NYC MAC plans to sell $398 mln of notes on Monday.
newsitem.headline: NYC MAC plans to sell $398 mln of notes on Monday.

text.p: Municipal Assistance Corp (MAC) of New York City plans to tap the market with a $398 million sale of variable rates notes this afternoon, a MAC official said Monday.
The official explained that about two-thirds of the offering would be remarketed every week, with the remaining one-third mananged like commercial paper.
Smith Barney Inc will lead the syndicate selling the notes, which are the MAC's second such offering.
"This will bring the total outstanding (of variable rates notes) up to about $500 million," said the MAC official, who declined to be named.
MAC, which was set up to rescue the city from its mid-1970 financial crisis, next plans to sell debt in the autumn.
